title: Rhenium as a material platform for long-lived transmon qubits
summary: Dielectric loss at the interfaces of superconducting films has long been recognized as limiting the performance of state-of-the-art superconducting circuits. Notably, the presence of a native oxide layer on the film is hypothesized to contribute to dielectric loss at the metal-air interface. Here, we explore rhenium as a candidate for the film, motivated by its remarkable property to suppress native oxide formation.
